telephony_platform.description: CTI platform that handled the call (cti-screenpop-adapter).

external_call_id.description: Telephony platform's call UUID; primary key against duplicate webhook delivery.

from_number.description: Caller phone number in E.164 format.

to_number.description: Callee phone number in E.164 format.

answered_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the call was answered (null when no-answer/abandoned).

ended_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the call ended.

duration_seconds.description: Talk duration in seconds (0 for missed/no-answer).

queue_name.description: Inbound queue or campaign that routed the call.

agent_skill.description: Skill tag attached to the agent who handled the call.

disposition_subject.description: Free-text subject summarising the call reason.

disposition_outcome.description: Agent-supplied call outcome that drives downstream workflow.

disposition_notes.description: Free-text notes captured by the agent on the disposition form.

recording_url.description: URL of the telephony-platform-hosted recording (audio file never stored in pipelinq).

recording_retention_expires_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp past which the platform deletes the recording.

cti_extension.description: Agent extension that handled the call.

ctiAdapterConfig.title: CTI Adapter Config
ctiAdapterConfig.summary: Per-organisation telephony platform configuration for the CTI screen-pop / click-to-dial adapter.
ctiAdapterConfig.description: Singleton record per organisation. Credentials are NEVER stored here — credentials_ref points at an OpenConnector source that owns the secret. Updated only by Pipelinq admins via the CTI admin settings page.

api_base_url.description: Base URL of the platform's REST API.

auth_method.description: Authentication method used against the platform's REST API.

credentials_ref.description: OpenConnector source UUID/slug that stores the platform credentials.

screen_pop_enabled.description: Whether inbound calls should auto-navigate the agent's tab to klantbeeld.

screen_pop_delay_ms.description: Delay before screen-pop fires so the agent hears the greeting first.

click_to_dial_enabled.description: Whether phone number fields render the click-to-dial icon.

default_outbound_caller_id.description: Caller-ID number presented on outbound click-to-dial calls.

webhook_secret.description: HMAC-SHA256 / shared-secret used to verify inbound webhook signatures.

default_country_code.description: ISO 3166 country code used as the default for phone number normalisation.

ctiEventLog.title: CTI Event Log
ctiEventLog.summary: Raw inbound CTI webhook events retained for 30 days for debugging and audit.
ctiEventLog.description: Append-only debugging log. Records platform, event type, external call id, full payload and processing status. Auto-cleanup job purges records older than 30 days.

received_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the webhook was received.

platform.description: Telephony platform that delivered the webhook.

external_call_id.description: Platform's call UUID, used to correlate event log with contactmoment.

payload_json.description: Full webhook body as received from the platform.

processing_error.description: Error message captured when processing failed (null on success).

signature_valid.description: Whether the webhook signature/auth check passed.

ctiAgentPresence.title: CTI Agent Presence
ctiAgentPresence.summary: Real-time agent presence state synced from the telephony platform.
ctiAgentPresence.description: One record per logged-in agent extension. Updated on presence webhook delivery; queue-management subscribes to the cti_agent_presence updated event.

user_id.description: Nextcloud user UID of the agent.

extension.description: Telephony extension number of the agent.

last_updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last presence update.
